mapper.insert: INSERT INTO METRO_TRANSFER_PUSH_TASK ( ID, ORDER_NO, THIRD_USER_ID, TRANS_DATE, TRANS_TIME, PAY_CHANNEL_TYPE, TRANSFER_FLAG, CARD_TYPE, STATUS, RETRY_COUNT, NEXT_RETRY_TIME, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME ) VALUES ( SEQ_METRO_TRANSFER_PUSH_TASK.NEXTVAL, #{orderNo}, #{thirdUserId}, #{transDate}, #{transTime}, #{payChannelType}, #{transferFlag}, #{cardType}, 'PENDING', 0, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ID, ORDER_NO, THIRD_USER_ID, TRANS_DATE, TRANS_TIME, PAY_CHANNEL_TYPE, TRANSFER_FLAG, CARD_TYPE, STATUS, RETRY_COUNT, NEXT_RETRY_TIME, LAST_ERROR FROM METRO_TRANSFER_PUSH_TASK WHERE STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY') AND NEXT_RETRY_TIME <= SYSTIMESTAMP ORDER BY NEXT_RETRY_TIME, ID ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE METRO_TRANSFER_PUSH_TASK SET STATUS = 'PROCESSING', UPDATE_TIME = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE ID = #{id} AND STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY') AND NEXT_RETRY_TIME <= SYSTIMESTAMP
UPDATE METRO_TRANSFER_PUSH_TASK SET STATUS = 'SUCCESS', LAST_ERROR = NULL, UPDATE_TIME = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE ID = #{id} AND STATUS = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE METRO_TRANSFER_PUSH_TASK SET STATUS = 'RETRY', RETRY_COUNT = #{retryCount}, NEXT_RETRY_TIME = #{nextRetryTime}, LAST_ERROR = #{lastError}, UPDATE_TIME = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE ID = #{id} AND STATUS = 'PROCESSING'
UPDATE METRO_TRANSFER_PUSH_TASK SET STATUS = 'FAILED', RETRY_COUNT = #{retryCount}, LAST_ERROR = #{lastError}, UPDATE_TIME = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE ID = #{id} AND STATUS = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE METRO_TRANSFER_PUSH_TASK SET STATUS = 'RETRY', NEXT_RETRY_TIME = SYSTIMESTAMP, LAST_ERROR = '任务处理租约超时', UPDATE_TIME = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE STATUS = 'PROCESSING' AND UPDATE_TIME < SYSTIMESTAMP - NUMTODSINTERVAL(#{leaseSeconds}, 'SECOND')
